text.p: Zimbabwe pace bowler Eddo Brandes took a sensational hat-trick to reduce England to 13 for three in the third one day international on Friday.

He had opener Nick Knight caught down the leg side with the last ball of his second over, the fourth of the innings, and with the first two balls of his next he removed John Crawley lbw and Nasser Hussain caught behind.
Brandes' hat-trick was the 11th in one-day internationals and the first against England who were chasing 250 to win.
The Zimbabwe chicken farmer is an old adversary of England. In the 1992 World Cup he took four wickets as Zimbabwe beat England in the first ever meeting between the two sides.
